영어 긴 문장 독해가 어려운 이유는 that절을 제대로 구분하지 못하기 때문입니다.

이번 영상에서는 명사절 that절과 관계절 that절이 문장 안에서 어떻게 다른지 보여드립니다.

짧은 문장에서 시작해 점점 긴 문장으로 확장하면서 that절을 실제 독해에서 어떻게 처리하는지 보여드립니다.

en-US.title: Make sure to watch this if you have trouble reading long sentences (last one)
en-US.description:
This is Teacher Tto, a Megastudy CSAT English instructor.

This is the final video in the "Gradual Reading" series.

The reason reading long English sentences is difficult is that students often fail to properly distinguish "that" clauses.

In this video, I will show you how noun clause "that" clauses and relative clause "that" clauses differ within a sentence.

Noun clause "that" clauses are core components that fill the subject or object positions, while relative clause "that" clauses are modifiers that explain the preceding noun.

If you cannot distinguish between the two types of "that" clauses, the sentence structure and the modifiers become mixed up, leading to a tangled interpretation.

I will demonstrate how to handle "that" clauses in actual reading comprehension, starting with short sentences and gradually expanding to longer ones.

You can take more detailed lectures on Megastudy.

점진적 독해는 문장의 필수 성분인 ‘주어,동사,목적어,보어’에 수식어(거품)이 붙어 짧은 문장에서 긴 문장으로 점점 길어지는 독해를 보여드립니다. 

영어 독해에 자신이 없는 학생들, 영어 독해로 힘들어하는 초보자들에게 영어에 대한 두려움을 줄여주는 강의가 될 것입니다.

이번 영상에서는 문장의 필수성분(주어 동사 목적어 보어)으로 뼈대를 먼저 잡고 전치사구를 묶어 읽는 방법을 보여드립니다

특히 전치사 뒤에 동명사(타동사+ing)가 나오는 경우에는 동명사 뒤의 목적어까지 하나로 묶어서 읽어야 한다는 점을 강조합니다

(전치사 + 동명사 + 목적어)를 하나의 덩어리로 처리하면 문장이 길어져도 구조가 훨씬 단순해집니다

en-US.title: You MUST watch this if you struggle with reading long sentences! 2
en-US.description:
Progressive Reading demonstrates a reading method where modifiers are attached to the essential components of a sentence—subject, verb, object, and complement—leading to sentences that gradually grow longer from short to long.

This course will help reduce the fear of English for students who lack confidence in reading comprehension and for beginners who struggle with the subject.

In this video, I will show you how to first establish the framework using the essential components of a sentence (subject, verb, object, and complement) and then read by grouping prepositional phrases together.

In particular, I emphasize that when a gerund (transitive verb + -ing) follows a preposition, you must read the object following the gerund as a single unit.

Treating (preposition + gerund + object) as a single block makes the structure much simpler, even as the sentence lengthens.

You can take the course at Megastudy for more details.

en-US.title: [D-1] How to Solve the March Mock English Exam [Must Watch for Grade 3 and Below] DAY 13
en-US.description:
In sentence ordering and insertion questions, demonstratives are crucial connecting clues.

One thing to note is that the same word may not always be repeated. While there are cases where the exact same word is repeated, there are also many instances where different expressions with the same meaning are repeated (various forms of repetition).

Therefore, when a demonstrative appears, you need to read the text by finding and connecting expressions with the same meaning in the preceding sentence.

In this video, I have summarized how to solve sentence ordering and insertion questions based on demonstratives using past KICE exams.

More detailed textbooks and lectures are available on the Megastudy online platform.
